title: KPI dashboards blank after network element upgrade
description: Reporting team raised missing KPI data after the upgrade weekend.
symptoms: Mediation rejects measurement files from upgraded nodes.
commands: check NetAct adaptation version for NE release
root_cause: OSS adaptation update was not scheduled together with the node upgrade.
resolution: Installed the matching NetAct adaptation and reloaded the PM files.
learning: Install the matching NetAct adaptation before upgrading network elements to a new release.

title: Mate gateway overloaded while draining CMG-15 for upgrade
description: Traffic drain step of MOP-UPG-04 executed on CMG-15 at 22:00.
symptoms: When user-plane traffic was drained to the mate gateway its CPU went above 95% and new PDN sessions were rejected.
commands: show system cpu; show session statistics
root_cause: The drain was executed at 22:00 while traffic was still near busy-hour level; the mate gateway did not have capacity for both loads.
resolution: Stopped the drain, rebalanced traffic back and rescheduled the upgrade after 01:00.
learning: Check mate gateway load and capacity (below 45%) before draining a CMG; drain only after the nightly traffic dip.

title: Rollback of CMG-12 upgrade took 4 hours - no exported configuration backup
description: Upgrade of CMG-12 failed at activation and rollback was required.
symptoms: Rollback could not restore the running configuration because the export was never copied off the node; config had to be rebuilt by hand.
commands: admin save; file copy cf3:/config.cfg backup-server:
root_cause: MOP step 2 (export configuration backup) was skipped because the backup server transfer failed silently and nobody checked it.
resolution: Rebuilt the configuration from the last change records and golden template; service restored after 4 hours.
learning: Confirm the configuration backup exists on the backup server (checksum) before starting any CMG upgrade.

title: Path management alarms flooding NetAct after gateway SW update on CMG-03
description: Gateway software update on CMG-03; alarms appeared right after the reboot step.
symptoms: NetAct flooded with path-down alarms from the gateway; no real subscriber impact observed.
commands: show gtp path-management; show alarms active
root_cause: New SW release introduced stricter GTP echo defaults; peers with high latency missed responses.
resolution: Set GTP echo interval back to 60s and N3 requests to 5; alarms cleared within 10 minutes.
learning: Compare GTP path-management timers before and after a CMG upgrade; release 24.7 changed the defaults.

title: FW-12 policy change dropped SCTP traffic to CMM
description: Firewall policy consolidation on FW-12 following MOP-FW-05.
symptoms: SCTP associations from RAN to the mobility manager dropped right after the policy push.
error_signature: S1 SETUP FAILURE; SCTP INIT no response
commands: show log traffic deny
root_cause: Rule consolidation treated the SCTP rule as unused because hit counters had been reset, and deleted it.
resolution: Re-added an explicit SCTP permit and verified S1 associations recovered.
learning: Never rely on hit counters alone to delete rules; confirm with traffic owners.

title: VoLTE interconnect down after TLS certificate replacement on SBC-01
description: Certificate rotation on SBC-01 ahead of expiry.
symptoms: Peer reports 'unknown CA' and drops the TLS session.
commands: openssl s_client -connect <peer>:5061 -showcerts
root_cause: The renewed certificate was issued by a new intermediate CA that was not included in the bundle.
resolution: Uploaded the full chain (leaf + intermediate) and restarted the TLS profile; trunks recovered.
learning: Validate the full certificate chain with 'openssl s_client -showcerts' against a peer before cut-over.

title: Migration of CMM-01 to new platform
description: Licenses transferred and verified before traffic swing.
learning: Licenses transferred and verified before traffic swing.

title: LB-02 marked every backend unhealthy after app release
description: Application update for the customer portal; traffic via LB-02.
symptoms: All pool members went red on the load balancer although the apps were running.
commands: curl -I http://<member>/health
root_cause: The health check URL changed in the new app version.
resolution: Temporarily kept the old /health path via app config, then updated the monitor.
learning: Test the health endpoint on the new version before switching traffic.

title: APN profile update on CMG-07
description: New APN added and tested; no impact.
learning: New APN added and tested; no impact.

title: VoLTE voice quality degraded after interface reconfiguration on ER-22
description: Uplink of ER-22 moved to a new 100G port.
symptoms: MOS dropped and VoLTE customers reported choppy audio after the uplink move.
commands: show policy-map interface <if>; show running-config interface <if>
root_cause: The service-policy was not re-attached when the subinterface was recreated on the new port.
resolution: Attached the QoS service-policy to the new interface; jitter normalised.
learning: When moving or recreating interfaces, re-attach QoS policies and verify with 'show policy-map interface'.

title: Uplink moved to new port on ER-21
description: QoS and MTU re-applied and verified.
learning: QoS and MTU re-applied and verified.

title: Upgrade of CNF on OCP-05 left pods crash looping
description: CNF minor release deployed via pipeline on OCP-05.
symptoms: Rolling update produced CrashLoopBackOff on every new pod.
commands: oc get pods -n cnf; oc logs <pod> --previous; oc get configmap -o yaml
root_cause: A mandatory configuration parameter for the new release was missing from the configmap.
resolution: Added the missing key to the configmap and restarted the rollout; pods became ready.
learning: Diff the configmap against the new release's required parameters before rolling out a new image.

title: Management access lost to sites after CR-05 restart
description: Restart of CR-05 for software maintenance.
symptoms: SSH to downstream nodes failed after the router restart; routing table missing static entries.
commands: show route static; show configuration | compare rollback 1
root_cause: Running vs startup configuration drift: unsaved routes were lost on restart.
resolution: Re-added the static routes from the change record and saved the configuration; reachability restored.
learning: Before any reload, diff running vs startup configuration and save pending changes.

title: ER-22: eBGP neighbours dropping every few minutes post patch
description: SMU installation on ER-22 following MOP-RTR-07.
symptoms: Neighbours kept resetting with hold timer expired after the SMU was applied.
commands: show bgp summary; show logging | include ADJCHANGE
root_cause: Custom BGP timers lived only in a config section that the patch overwrote; the defaults came back.
resolution: Restored the BGP timer configuration from backup and added it to the golden config enforced by automation.
learning: Keep BGP timers in the golden config so automation re-applies them after vendor patches.

title: Load balancer LB-01 health monitor failing after application update
description: New version of the API gateway deployed behind LB-01.
symptoms: Health monitor returned 404; the pool was empty.
commands: show ltm pool members; show ltm monitor http
root_cause: The monitor path was not updated together with the release.
resolution: Updated the LB monitor path; pool members came back up.
learning: Before app upgrades behind a load balancer, confirm the health-check endpoint is unchanged or update the monitor.

title: CMG-03 upgrade: traffic drain caused CPU overload on the pair gateway
description: Drain of CMG-03 started earlier than planned due to window constraints.
symptoms: Mate CMG overload alarms and session setup failures during the drain step.
commands: show system cpu; show session statistics
root_cause: Drain started before the traffic dip; mate node already at 60% load.
resolution: Stopped the drain, rebalanced traffic back and rescheduled the upgrade after 01:00.
learning: Check mate gateway load and capacity (below 45%) before draining a CMG; drain only after the nightly traffic dip.

title: Stale alarm entries for CMM-06 remain in NetAct after upgrade
description: NOC reported ghost alarms for CMM-06 in NetAct after the maintenance window.
symptoms: Operators see ghost alarms for the CMM in NetAct; alarm lists on node and OSS do not match.
commands: ps -o pid,stat,cmd -p $(pgrep -f snmpservice.py); kubectl get pods -n alms
root_cause: NetAct maintenance mode was left enabled after the window and the SNMP agent served outdated alarm entries.
resolution: Removed maintenance mode in NetAct, backed up /var/log on the alarm pod, restarted the snmpagent process and waited about 2 minutes; stale alarms disappeared after resync.
learning: After CMM upgrades, remove NetAct maintenance mode and compare node vs NetAct alarm lists before closing the change.

title: ENB-4415 integration caused call drops on neighbour cells
description: Capacity site ENB-4415 integrated into the cluster.
symptoms: Customers near the new site experienced dropped calls while moving.
commands: check PCI plan; neighbour relation table
root_cause: The PCI plan was not refreshed before integration; duplicate PCI in the neighbourhood.
resolution: Changed the PCI of the new cell and refreshed neighbour relations; KPIs recovered.
learning: Run a PCI conflict/confusion check against neighbours before site integration.

title: Subscriber data missing on standby after HSS-03 database failover
description: Active/standby swap of the subscriber database on HSS-03.
symptoms: Provisioning team reported recent changes missing on the new active site.
commands: show db replication status
root_cause: Switchover done while replication was degraded after a link flap.
resolution: Switched back, waited for replication to catch up, then repeated the switchover.
learning: Check database replication lag is near zero before any HSS switchover.

title: CR-06 lost static routes after reboot
description: Router CR-06 rebooted as part of a line card replacement.
symptoms: Static routes configured last month disappeared after reboot; management traffic blackholed.
commands: show route 10.0.0.0/8
root_cause: The previous engineer did not save the configuration, so the reboot dropped the unsaved static routes.
resolution: Restored routes from backup, committed the config and added a running/startup diff check to the MOP.
learning: Always save/commit configuration at the end of each change; check config drift before reboots.

title: No alarms or PM data from CMG-03 after release activation
description: Software update of CMG-03; PM reports empty after the change.
symptoms: OSS showed the node unmanaged; the NOC was blind to node alarms.
error_signature: PM file transfer failed: permission denied
commands: show snmp usm users; show snmp statistics
root_cause: Release activation replaced the SNMP config; the OSS credentials were no longer valid.
resolution: Re-created the SNMPv3 user with the agreed credentials and re-integrated the node in NetAct.
learning: After upgrades, confirm the node is managed in NetAct (alarms and PM flowing) before closing the change.

title: CNF pods in CrashLoopBackOff after image upgrade on OCP-04
description: Rolling update of the policy CNF to a new image version on OCP-04.
symptoms: New pods failed readiness and restarted continuously; old replicas were already terminated, causing capacity loss.
commands: oc get pods -n cnf; oc logs <pod> --previous; oc get configmap -o yaml
root_cause: The new image version required a new configmap key that was not added before the rollout.
resolution: Added the missing key to the configmap and restarted the rollout; pods became ready.
learning: Diff the configmap against the new release's required parameters before rolling out a new image.

title: CMM-01 upgrade aborted: no space left on device
description: Upgrade of CMM-01 to 26.7 per MOP-UPG-02.
symptoms: Package transfer failed midway and the upgrade framework aborted the procedure.
commands: df -h /var/log; du -sh /var/log/*
root_cause: The /var/log partition was 97% full due to debug logging left enabled from a previous troubleshooting session.
resolution: Archived and removed old logs and core files, disabled debug logging and re-ran the upgrade in the next window.
learning: Check free disk space on /var/log (need more than 30% free) before starting a CMM upgrade; disable leftover debug logging.

title: CMG-09 upgrade fallback delayed: config backup missing on backup server
description: Software upgrade on CMG-09 had to be reverted; restoring the old configuration took far longer than planned.
symptoms: Fallback to the previous release worked but the custom configuration was lost; the backup file was not on the backup server.
commands: file dir backup/
root_cause: The configuration backup was saved locally on the node only; the local disk was reformatted during the failed upgrade.
resolution: Recovered config from the peer node and the change history, then reverted the release.
learning: Never keep the only backup on the node being upgraded; verify the off-box copy as a go/no-go check.

title: CMG-07 SW upgrade to 24.3: throughput drop and BFD flaps after re-enabling sessions
description: Planned upgrade of CMG-07 to release 24.3 following MOP-UPG-04. Upgrade itself completed; issues started at step 7 when sessions were re-enabled.
symptoms: After activating release 24.3 and re-enabling sessions, GTP-U throughput dropped about 40% and BFD sessions to the PE routers went down repeatedly.
commands: show bfd session; show interface ethernet-1/1 detail; show router bgp summary
root_cause: The software upgrade reset interface MTU from 9000 (jumbo) to the vendor default 1500 and BFD timers from 300ms x3 back to the default 1000ms x3; the custom values were not part of the post-upgrade config template.
resolution: Re-applied MTU 9000 on all uplink interfaces and restored BFD interval 300ms multiplier 3, then re-enabled the BGP sessions. Pinned both values in the post-upgrade config template.
learning: Verify interface MTU and BFD timers against the pre-check snapshot before re-enabling sessions after a CMG upgrade; upgrades can silently revert them to defaults.

title: Partial outage after router redundancy failover on CR-06
description: Annual resilience test of the CR-06 gateway pair.
symptoms: Stale gateway MAC on downstream switches; traffic dropped.
commands: show vrrp detail; show arp
root_cause: The virtual MAC was not used; failover changed the gateway MAC without GARP.
resolution: Cleared ARP on the downstream switches and enabled gratuitous ARP on failover; retest successful.
learning: Check VRRP gratuitous ARP / virtual MAC settings before failover tests.

title: CMG-15 shown as unreachable in NetAct after upgrade
description: Upgrade of CMG-15 to 24.7 completed; OSS integration check failed.
symptoms: NetAct reported the node as disconnected; no alarms or PM counters received since the upgrade.
commands: show snmp usm users; show snmp statistics
root_cause: The upgrade reset the SNMPv3 user credentials to defaults, so NetAct authentication failed.
resolution: Re-created the SNMPv3 user with the agreed credentials and re-integrated the node in NetAct.
learning: After upgrades, confirm the node is managed in NetAct (alarms and PM flowing) before closing the change.

title: Adaptation package installed for CMG 24.7
description: Adaptation installed ahead of node upgrades.
learning: Adaptation installed ahead of node upgrades.

title: Link up but no traffic after transport integration on ER-22
description: New leased line connected to ER-22.
symptoms: Site integration delayed: the transport link passes no packets.
commands: show interface <if>.210; show arp
root_cause: dot1q tag mismatch between the router and the transport provider.
resolution: Corrected the dot1q tag to match the provider; traffic flowed.
learning: Confirm VLAN IDs with the transport provider in writing before commissioning.

title: Alarms out of sync between CMM-04 (26.7) and NetAct
description: After upgrading CMM-04 to 26.7 the alarm lists on the node and in NetAct differ.
symptoms: NetAct keeps showing alarms that are no longer active on the CMM; they cannot be acknowledged or deleted.
error_signature: stale alarm returned by SNMP get; alarm resync mismatch
commands: ps -o pid,stat,cmd -p $(pgrep -f snmpservice.py); kubectl get pods -n alms
root_cause: The SNMP agent process on the alarm management pod kept a stale cached alarm table after the upgrade, and NetAct was still in maintenance mode so updates were not processed.
resolution: Removed maintenance mode in NetAct, backed up /var/log on the alarm pod, restarted the snmpagent process and waited about 2 minutes; stale alarms disappeared after resync.
learning: After CMM upgrades, remove NetAct maintenance mode and compare node vs NetAct alarm lists before closing the change.

title: Time not synchronised on replaced unit of HSS-02
description: Field replacement of a blade in HSS-02.
symptoms: Certificate validation errors and log correlation issues after the hardware replacement.
commands: chronyc tracking; chronyc sources
root_cause: The replacement procedure missed the time-sync configuration.
resolution: Configured NTP servers and forced a time sync; rejects stopped.
learning: After any hardware replacement, verify NTP sync status (stratum, offset) before returning the node to service.

title: QoS policy missing on new uplink of ER-30
description: Subinterface re-creation on ER-30 during port consolidation.
symptoms: QCI-1 traffic not prioritised on the new interface.
commands: show policy-map interface <if>; show running-config interface <if>
root_cause: The interface migration procedure did not include re-applying QoS.
resolution: Attached the QoS service-policy to the new interface; jitter normalised.
learning: When moving or recreating interfaces, re-attach QoS policies and verify with 'show policy-map interface'.

title: BGP flapping on edge router ER-30 after firmware push - MTU mismatch
description: Firmware upgrade of ER-30 to 7.11.1 using MOP-RTR-07.
symptoms: After the firmware push BGP sessions came up but dropped when full table updates were exchanged; pings with large packets failed.
commands: show interface | include MTU; ping <peer> size 9000 df-bit
root_cause: Firmware 7.11 reset interface MTU to the vendor default (1514) while the peer used 9216, so large BGP updates were dropped.
resolution: Pinned MTU 9216 in the post-upgrade config template and re-applied it; sessions stable.
learning: Verify interface MTU on both ends after any router firmware upgrade before re-enabling peering.

title: Authentication failures after DNS resolver change on CMM-06
description: Migration of CMM-06 to the new DNS resolver pair.
symptoms: S6a Diameter peers went down; attaches failed with authentication errors.
error_signature: Diameter peer DOWN: DNS resolution failed
commands: nslookup hss01.epc.example <new-resolver>; show diameter peers
root_cause: The new DNS resolvers lacked the internal EPC zone, so the HSS peer FQDN no longer resolved when connections were re-established.
resolution: Added the EPC zone forwarder on the new resolvers and restarted the Diameter peers.
learning: Before switching DNS resolvers, resolve every Diameter peer FQDN from the node against the new servers.

title: Worker patching on OCP-04 completed
description: All workers drained and patched within the window.
learning: All workers drained and patched within the window.

title: Periodic RAN backhaul outages after SecGW software update on SEG-03
description: Upgrade of SEG-03 to fix a crypto vulnerability.
symptoms: IKE SA renegotiation failures logged regularly.
commands: show crypto ikev2 sa; show crypto ipsec sa
root_cause: The crypto profile reverted to the new defaults after the upgrade.
resolution: Re-configured the crypto profile with the previous lifetime and PFS group; tunnels stable.
learning: Snapshot IKE/IPsec proposals before SecGW upgrades and compare after.

title: Handover failures near new eNodeB ENB-5120
description: New eNodeB ENB-5120 brought on air.
symptoms: Handover failures and RRC re-establishments increased around the new site.
commands: KPI: HO success rate per cell
root_cause: PCI conflict between the new cell and an existing neighbour.
resolution: Re-planned the PCI with the SON tool and re-integrated the site.
learning: Monitor handover KPIs for 24 hours after integrating a new site.

title: Minor version update of OCP-05
description: Cluster updated to 4.16.x; operators healthy.
learning: Cluster updated to 4.16.x; operators healthy.

title: New partner VPN rule on FW-11
description: Rule added; traffic verified.
learning: Rule added; traffic verified.

title: Wrong timestamps after hardware swap on HSS-03
description: Hardware swap on HSS-03 after a disk failure.
symptoms: Records from the node carried timestamps in the future and mediation rejected batches.
commands: timedatectl status
root_cause: NTP configuration was not restored after the board swap.
resolution: Restored the NTP config from backup and re-sent the affected records to mediation.
learning: Add a time-sync check to replacement procedures.

title: Application pods failing to start after container image update on OCP-02
description: Container image bump for the charging CNF on OCP-02.
symptoms: Pods crash on start with a config error; rollout stuck at 50%.
commands: oc rollout status deployment/<name>; oc describe pod
root_cause: The configmap was not updated to the new schema expected by the upgraded image.
resolution: Rolled back to the previous image, updated the configmap, then re-ran the upgrade.
learning: Use maxUnavailable 0 / surge rollouts so capacity is kept if new pods fail.

title: Revenue leakage on CMG-07: online charging bypassed following Diameter peer update
description: Reconfiguration of Diameter realm routing for online charging on CMG-07.
symptoms: Charging team saw a drop in charged volume after the peer update; Diameter Tx timer expiries on the gateway.
error_signature: Diameter peer state OKAY but no CCA received
commands: show diameter peer; show diameter realm-routing
root_cause: Typo in the destination realm during the peer update made credit-control requests undeliverable.
resolution: Corrected the Destination-Realm and the realm routing table; CCR/CCA success rate back to 99.9%.
learning: Before changing Diameter/Gy peers, send a test CCR to the new peer and check realm routing; monitor charged volume right after the change.

title: NetAct showing cleared alarms of CMM-01 as still active
description: Post-upgrade alarm sync check failed for CMM-01.
symptoms: Historical alarms reappear in NetAct after every resync even though the mobility manager cleared them.
error_signature: NetAct alarm upload contains cancelled alarms
commands: snmpwalk alarm table; check NetAct maintenance mode
root_cause: Alarm cache in the snmpagent service was not refreshed after the release activation; resync uploaded historical entries.
resolution: Restarted the SNMP agent service on the alarm management pod during a maintenance window and triggered a manual alarm resync from NetAct.
learning: Restarting the snmpagent process clears stale alarms; do it in a maintenance window and back up logs first.

title: HSS-02: recently provisioned SIMs rejected after site switchover
description: Geo-redundancy switchover test on HSS-02.
symptoms: Newly activated SIM cards rejected with unknown subscriber after the switchover.
commands: check replication lag on standby
root_cause: The standby database was behind the active; recent provisioning had not replicated yet.
resolution: Re-provisioned the affected subscribers and resynchronised the databases.
learning: Add a replication status go/no-go check to the switchover procedure.

title: Performance reports empty for upgraded nodes
description: Post-upgrade PM data validation failed.
symptoms: KPI dashboards show no data for nodes upgraded over the weekend.
commands: PM loader logs
root_cause: Mediation adaptation version mismatch with the upgraded node release.
resolution: Deployed the adaptation package and re-processed the rejected files.
learning: Include OSS adaptation readiness in the upgrade go/no-go checklist.

title: Mobility manager CMM-01 capacity capped after hardware migration
description: Hardware refresh of CMM-01; configuration restored on the new platform.
symptoms: Registered subscribers flat-lined at exactly 500k and new attaches were rejected.
commands: show alarms active | include LICENSE
root_cause: License file bound to the old node ID; the new node fell back to base capacity.
resolution: Obtained a re-hosted license and installed it; verified the capacity counters.
learning: Include a license capacity check in the post-migration checklist.

title: VLAN mismatch on new transport link at ER-25
description: Transport integration for new site cluster on ER-25.
symptoms: Pings across the new link fail although the optics are fine.
commands: monitor interface traffic
root_cause: VLAN ID typo in the design sheet.
resolution: Aligned the VLAN ID with the transport team and updated the design record.
learning: Use packet capture / counters to check tagging when a new link passes no traffic.

title: Clock drift on HSS-02 after board replacement
description: Faulty board replaced on HSS-02.
symptoms: Logs and alarms on the replaced unit were 7 minutes behind; authentication vectors were rejected intermittently.
commands: chronyc tracking; chronyc sources
root_cause: The replacement hardware came with factory settings; NTP servers were not configured as part of the replacement procedure.
resolution: Configured NTP servers and forced a time sync; rejects stopped.
learning: After any hardware replacement, verify NTP sync status (stratum, offset) before returning the node to service.

title: Line card replacement on CMG-03
description: Card replaced; interfaces and MTU verified.
learning: Card replaced; interfaces and MTU verified.

title: S6a peers down on CMM-04 following DNS server migration
description: DNS server change for the core network; CMM-04 reconfigured.
symptoms: The mobility manager could not reconnect to the HSS after a planned peer restart.
commands: dig +short hss01.epc.example
root_cause: The resolver migration missed the private 3GPP zone, so peer FQDN lookups failed.
resolution: Temporarily configured static host entries for the HSS peers, then fixed the DNS zone.
learning: Keep a list of critical FQDNs (HSS, PCRF, OCS) and test them as a pre-check.

title: VRRP failover test on CR-05
description: Failover and failback successful within 3s.
learning: Failover and failback successful within 3s.

title: PM counters missing in NetAct after node release upgrade
description: Network elements upgraded to a new release; NetAct adaptation not updated.
symptoms: PM files arrive but counters are not loaded; reports show gaps.
error_signature: unknown measurement type; adaptation not found
commands: check NetAct adaptation version for NE release
root_cause: The NetAct adaptation for the new node release was not installed before the node upgrade.
resolution: Installed the matching NetAct adaptation and reloaded the PM files.
learning: Install the matching NetAct adaptation before upgrading network elements to a new release.

title: Security gateway SEG-04 tunnels flapping at rekey
description: SecGW SEG-04 updated to the latest maintenance release.
symptoms: Periodic disconnects of sites every hour exactly.
commands: show crypto profile
root_cause: IKE proposal defaults changed in the new software (PFS group 14 vs 2).
resolution: Aligned the IKE/IPsec proposals with the RAN configuration.
learning: Watch the first rekey cycle after the change before closing it.

title: Upgrade of mobility manager CMM-06 failed at image copy step
description: Release upgrade on CMM-06; image transfer started on schedule.
symptoms: Upgrade precheck passed but image extraction failed with disk errors.
commands: df -h; find /var/log -size +500M
root_cause: Old core dumps and debug logs filled the log partition used as the upgrade staging area.
resolution: Cleaned /var/log and added a disk-space check to the precheck script.
learning: Add 'df -h' to the upgrade pre-checks and abort early if staging space is low.

title: New eNodeB tunnels on SEG-03
description: Tunnels established for 12 new sites.
learning: Tunnels established for 12 new sites.

title: Authentication failures for new subscribers after HSS-03 DB switchover
description: Planned database switchover of HSS-03 to the secondary site.
symptoms: Subscribers provisioned in the last hour could not register; older subscribers were fine.
commands: show db replication status
root_cause: Replication to the standby site lagged by about an hour, and the switchover was executed without checking the lag.
resolution: Switched back, waited for replication to catch up, then repeated the switchover.
learning: Check database replication lag is near zero before any HSS switchover.

title: IPsec tunnels to eNodeBs dropping every hour after SEG-03 upgrade
description: Software upgrade of security gateway SEG-03.
symptoms: Tunnels went down at each rekey interval (60 min), causing short S1 outages.
commands: show crypto ikev2 sa; show crypto ipsec sa
root_cause: The upgrade changed the default Child SA lifetime and PFS group; eNodeBs proposed the old values so rekey failed.
resolution: Re-configured the crypto profile with the previous lifetime and PFS group; tunnels stable.
learning: Snapshot IKE/IPsec proposals before SecGW upgrades and compare after.

title: Attach rejects at busy hour after CMM-04 migration
description: Migration of CMM-04 to new hardware.
symptoms: At 19:00 attach success rate dropped to 80% with rejects although load was normal.
error_signature: EMM cause #22 congestion; license capacity exceeded
commands: show license capacity; show subscriber count
root_cause: The capacity license was not transferred to the new hardware; the node ran with the default trial capacity.
resolution: Installed the correct capacity license for the new node ID; rejects stopped immediately.
learning: After any migration, verify installed license capacity matches the old node before the traffic swing.

title: BGP session flapping on edge router ER-21 after vendor patch
description: Vendor patch installed on ER-21 to fix a security advisory.
symptoms: eBGP sessions to the transit provider flapped every 3-4 minutes after the patch; routes withdrawn and re-advertised.
commands: show bgp neighbor | include hold time; show running-config router bgp
root_cause: The vendor patch reverted the custom BGP keepalive/hold timers (10/30) to defaults (60/180) on our side while the peer kept aggressive timers, causing hold-timer expiry under load.
resolution: Re-applied keepalive 10 / hold 30 via automation and soft-reset the sessions; peering stable.
learning: Record BGP timers before patching edge routers and verify them after the reload, before declaring the change complete.

title: SIP TLS handshake failures after certificate renewal on SBC-01
description: Annual TLS certificate renewal on SBC-01 using MOP-CRT-01.
symptoms: After installing the renewed certificate the interconnect partner rejected TLS connections; calls to that partner failed.
commands: openssl s_client -connect <peer>:5061 -showcerts
root_cause: The new certificate was installed without the intermediate CA certificate, so peers could not build the trust chain.
resolution: Uploaded the full chain (leaf + intermediate) and restarted the TLS profile; trunks recovered.
learning: Validate the full certificate chain with 'openssl s_client -showcerts' against a peer before cut-over.

title: Session drops on mate CMG during traffic drain of CMG-07
description: Upgrade window for CMG-07; user-plane traffic moved to the mate gateway before activation.
symptoms: During the drain the pair gateway started dropping sessions and attach success fell.
error_signature: PDN connectivity reject cause #26 insufficient resources
commands: show redundancy status
root_cause: Capacity check of the mate gateway was not done; combined sessions exceeded its licensed and CPU capacity.
resolution: Paused the change, waited for low traffic and drained in two batches.
learning: Drain user-plane traffic in batches and watch mate CPU between batches.

title: TAC list update on CMM-06
description: Tracking area list updated; attach success unchanged.
learning: Tracking area list updated; attach success unchanged.

title: ER-21 firmware 7.11 reset interface MTU, peering unstable
description: Firmware push to ER-21; router reloaded and interfaces came back up.
symptoms: Sessions stuck or flapping during route exchange; small pings ok, large packets dropped.
commands: show ospf neighbor; show bgp summary
root_cause: MTU mismatch introduced by the firmware default reset on the edge router.
resolution: Re-configured the interface MTU to match the peer and cleared the BGP sessions.
learning: Pin MTU in the post-upgrade template so firmware defaults cannot override it.

title: eNodeBs lost S1 connection after firewall rule cleanup on FW-11
description: Rule-base cleanup on FW-11 to remove unused rules.
symptoms: Hundreds of eNodeBs reported S1 link down; attach failures spiked.
error_signature: SCTP ABORT; S1 link failure alarm
commands: diagnose sniffer packet any 'port 36412'; show firewall policy
root_cause: Firewall rule cleanup removed the rule permitting SCTP (protocol 132) port 36412; only TCP/UDP were kept.
resolution: Restored the SCTP 36412 rule from the policy backup; associations re-established within 5 minutes.
learning: Before firewall cleanups, check rules carrying SCTP/Diameter (36412, 3868) and verify associations immediately after the push.

title: Peering instability with transit provider after SMU install on ER-25
description: Patch window for ER-25; router reloaded as part of the SMU install.
symptoms: Customer traffic rerouted repeatedly; BGP adjacency changes logged continuously.
commands: show bgp neighbor | include hold time; show running-config router bgp
root_cause: SMU install restarted the BGP process with default timers while the peer expected 10/30.
resolution: Re-applied keepalive 10 / hold 30 via automation and soft-reset the sessions; peering stable.
learning: Record BGP timers before patching edge routers and verify them after the reload, before declaring the change complete.

title: OCP-04 maintenance overran: drain blocked by PodDisruptionBudget
description: Patch rollout for OCP-04 worker pool.
symptoms: Drain command retried evictions endlessly and the patch window was exceeded.
commands: oc get pdb -A; oc describe pdb
root_cause: The PDB allowed zero disruptions for the CNF pods, so the drain could not proceed.
resolution: Coordinated with the app team to relax the PDB during the window; the drain completed.
learning: Run 'oc get pdb -A' as a pre-check and agree a plan with app owners if ALLOWED DISRUPTIONS is 0.

title: Firmware upgrade on ER-21 completed
description: Firmware 7.11.1 installed; MTU and BGP timers verified after reload.
learning: Firmware 7.11.1 installed; MTU and BGP timers verified after reload.

title: Subscribers getting free data after Gy peer change on CMG-12
description: Change to point CMG-12 Gy interface to the new OCS cluster.
symptoms: After changing the OCS Diameter peer, CCR-I requests timed out and the gateway applied failure handling CONTINUE, so data was not charged.
commands: show diameter peer; show diameter realm-routing
root_cause: The new OCS peer was configured with a wrong Destination-Realm, so requests were routed to an unreachable host and failure handling defaulted to CONTINUE.
resolution: Corrected the Destination-Realm and the realm routing table; CCR/CCA success rate back to 99.9%.
learning: Before changing Diameter/Gy peers, send a test CCR to the new peer and check realm routing; monitor charged volume right after the change.

title: Jitter on voice traffic after link migration on ER-25
description: Link migration on ER-25 to new line card.
symptoms: Voice packets queued as best effort; jitter above 60ms at busy hour.
commands: show qos interface
root_cause: The QoS policy is bound to the interface, so moving the link removed it.
resolution: Re-applied the QoS policy and verified DSCP EF queueing.
learning: Compare interface config (QoS, MTU, ACL) before and after a link migration.

title: Worker node drain stuck during OCP-02 patching
description: Monthly OS patching of worker nodes on OCP-02 following MOP-OCP-03.
symptoms: oc adm drain hung for 45 minutes on worker-3; eviction kept failing.
error_signature: Cannot evict pod as it would violate the pod's disruption budget
commands: oc adm drain worker-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data; oc get pdb -A
root_cause: An application PodDisruptionBudget had minAvailable equal to its replica count (2/2), so no pod could ever be evicted.
resolution: Temporarily scaled the deployment to 3 replicas so the PDB allowed one disruption, then drained and patched the node.
learning: Check all PodDisruptionBudgets for zero allowed disruptions before draining OCP nodes.

title: Portal release behind LB-02
description: Health monitor checked before switch; release successful.
learning: Health monitor checked before switch; release successful.

title: CMG-15: GTP-C echo timeouts towards peers following release activation
description: Release 24.7 activated on CMG-15. NOC raised a ticket for alarm flood during post-checks.
symptoms: Echo request timeouts reported for many GTP-C peers right after the new release was activated; KPIs looked fine.
commands: show gtp peer statistics
root_cause: Default GTP path management timers changed in the new release; the old customised echo interval was not migrated.
resolution: Re-applied the customised path-management profile (echo 60s, N3=5) and cleared the stale alarms in NetAct.
learning: Include GTP echo timer settings in the CMG pre-check snapshot.

title: CMG-03: credit-control requests timing out after OCS peer reconfiguration
description: OCS migration: Diameter peer configuration updated on CMG-03.
symptoms: Gy CCR timeouts spiked to 30%; sessions were allowed without quota.
commands: show charging gy statistics
root_cause: Diameter realm routing entry still pointed to the old OCS; the Tx timer expired and CCFH CONTINUE let sessions through uncharged.
resolution: Fixed realm routing and temporarily set CCFH to TERMINATE for new sessions until charging was confirmed.
learning: Verify credit-control success rate for 15 minutes after any charging configuration change.

title: Diameter peer to HSS not resolving after resolver update on CMM-01
description: Resolver update on CMM-01 as part of the DNS consolidation project.
symptoms: Subscriber registration failures increasing; Diameter connections closed.
commands: nslookup hss01.epc.example <new-resolver>; show diameter peers
root_cause: The DNS forwarder for the EPC domain was not configured on the new resolvers.
resolution: Added the EPC zone forwarder on the new resolvers and restarted the Diameter peers.
learning: Before switching DNS resolvers, resolve every Diameter peer FQDN from the node against the new servers.

title: Roaming partner profile on HSS-02
description: Profile added; test subscribers registered.
learning: Profile added; test subscribers registered.

title: Self-care portal down after backend upgrade - all pool members down on LB-01
description: Release of the self-care portal backend behind LB-01.
symptoms: Users received HTTP 503 from the portal right after the app release.
error_signature: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable; pool has no available members
commands: show ltm pool members; show ltm monitor http
root_cause: The application release moved the health endpoint from /health to /actuator/health; the LB monitor still polled the old path.
resolution: Updated the LB monitor path; pool members came back up.
learning: Before app upgrades behind a load balancer, confirm the health-check endpoint is unchanged or update the monitor.

title: Mass S1 setup failures following firewall change on FW-11
description: Quarterly firewall hygiene change on FW-11.
symptoms: S1-MME associations failing; RAN alarms 'S1 link failure' across a region.
commands: diagnose sniffer packet any 'port 36412'; show firewall policy
root_cause: SCTP was not covered by the new 'any service' object, which only included TCP/UDP.
resolution: Restored the SCTP 36412 rule from the policy backup; associations re-established within 5 minutes.
learning: Before firewall cleanups, check rules carrying SCTP/Diameter (36412, 3868) and verify associations immediately after the push.

title: False GTP path failure alarms after CMG-09 upgrade to 24.7
description: Upgrade of CMG-09 to 24.7 using MOP-UPG-04. Post-checks showed a large number of new alarms.
symptoms: Dozens of 'GTP path failure' alarms raised towards eNodeB peers although traffic was normal.
commands: show gtp path-management; show alarms active
root_cause: Release 24.7 changed the default GTP echo interval from 60s to 20s with N3=2, which was too aggressive for peers behind a slow transport.
resolution: Set GTP echo interval back to 60s and N3 requests to 5; alarms cleared within 10 minutes.
learning: Compare GTP path-management timers before and after a CMG upgrade; release 24.7 changed the defaults.

title: Post-upgrade instability on packet core gateway CMG-03 - BGP peers bouncing, large packets dropped
description: Release activation on CMG-03 per MOP-UPG-04. After reboot and session re-enable the gateway became unstable and the change was escalated.
symptoms: Once traffic was restored the BGP neighbours kept going up and down every few minutes and subscribers reported slow data; large packets were being fragmented.
error_signature: BFD state DOWN (detect time expired); GTP-U packet too big
commands: show interface mtu; show bfd session detail; ping -s 8900 -M do <peer>
root_cause: Upgrade to 24.3 re-applied factory defaults on the uplink interfaces: MTU fell back to 1500 and the BFD transmit/receive interval reverted to default, so peers timed out and jumbo GTP-U packets were fragmented.
resolution: Restored jumbo MTU and the custom BFD timers from the pre-upgrade backup, bounced the BFD sessions and confirmed stable BGP for 30 minutes.
learning: Add MTU and BFD timer checks to the MOP-UPG-04 post-checks and keep both values in the post-upgrade config template.

title: Cluster patching on OCP-05 exceeded maintenance window - pods could not be evicted
description: Kernel patch on OCP-05; each worker drained and rebooted in turn.
symptoms: Node stayed SchedulingDisabled with pods not evicted; change rolled back at end of window.
error_signature: eviction retry loop: too many requests (429)
commands: oc adm drain worker-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data; oc get pdb -A
root_cause: PodDisruptionBudget misconfigured (maxUnavailable 0) blocked eviction.
resolution: Temporarily scaled the deployment to 3 replicas so the PDB allowed one disruption, then drained and patched the node.
learning: Check all PodDisruptionBudgets for zero allowed disruptions before draining OCP nodes.

title: Rule cleanup on FW-11
description: SCTP/Diameter rules verified untouched; cleanup done.
learning: SCTP/Diameter rules verified untouched; cleanup done.

title: Routine upgrade of CMG-09 to 24.7 completed
description: Upgrade executed per MOP-UPG-04; all post-checks passed.
learning: Upgrade executed per MOP-UPG-04; all post-checks passed.

title: OAM network unreachable after core router CR-05 reload
description: Planned reload of CR-05 to clear a memory leak.
symptoms: After the planned reload NetAct lost connectivity to 40 sites; OAM subnets unreachable.
commands: show route static; show configuration | compare rollback 1
root_cause: Static routes were added in an earlier change only to the running configuration and never committed/saved, so the reload removed them.
resolution: Re-added the static routes from the change record and saved the configuration; reachability restored.
learning: Before any reload, diff running vs startup configuration and save pending changes.

title: CMM-04 release activation stopped due to full log partition
description: Planned upgrade window for CMM-04.
symptoms: Release activation stopped; node remained on the old release and the window was lost.
commands: df -h /var/log; du -sh /var/log/*
root_cause: A debug trace left on after a past case filled the disk.
resolution: Archived and removed old logs and core files, disabled debug logging and re-ran the upgrade in the next window.
learning: Check free disk space on /var/log (need more than 30% free) before starting a CMM upgrade; disable leftover debug logging.

title: Certificate renewed on SBC-01
description: Full chain installed and validated with peers.
learning: Full chain installed and validated with peers.

title: Traffic blackholed after VRRP failover test on CR-06
description: Planned VRRP failover test on CR-06.
symptoms: After the planned failover some servers lost connectivity for 20 minutes.
error_signature: VRRP state change Master->Backup; ARP entry stale
commands: show vrrp detail; show arp
root_cause: The new master did not send gratuitous ARP because 'garp on failover' was disabled; downstream devices kept the old MAC.
resolution: Cleared ARP on the downstream switches and enabled gratuitous ARP on failover; retest successful.
learning: Check VRRP gratuitous ARP / virtual MAC settings before failover tests.

title: CMG-15 upgraded to 24.3
description: Pre-check snapshot compared after upgrade; no deviations.
learning: Pre-check snapshot compared after upgrade; no deviations.

title: SBC-02: interconnect calls failing after cert update
description: Replacement of the expiring interconnect certificate on SBC-02.
symptoms: SIP over TLS trunks went down right after the certificate swap.
error_signature: SSL handshake failed: certificate verify failed
commands: show tls profile; show sip trunk status
root_cause: Incomplete certificate chain uploaded; the intermediate CA was missing.
resolution: Re-imported the certificate bundle with the intermediate CA and verified with openssl s_client.
learning: Always install the leaf and intermediate certificates together during renewal.

title: New backhaul link on ER-30 carrying no traffic after commissioning
description: Commissioning of a new backhaul link on ER-30.
symptoms: Interface up/up but no ARP resolution or traffic across the new link.
commands: show interface <if>.210; show arp
root_cause: The subinterface was configured with VLAN 210 while the transport provider delivered VLAN 201.
resolution: Corrected the dot1q tag to match the provider; traffic flowed.
learning: Confirm VLAN IDs with the transport provider in writing before commissioning.

title: Dropped calls in cluster after new site ENB-4411 integration
description: Integration of new site ENB-4411.
symptoms: Call drop rate doubled in neighbouring cells after the new site went on air.
commands: check PCI plan; neighbour relation table
root_cause: The new site was planned with a PCI already used by a neighbour cell (PCI confusion).
resolution: Changed the PCI of the new cell and refreshed neighbour relations; KPIs recovered.
learning: Run a PCI conflict/confusion check against neighbours before site integration.

title: CMM-04 upgraded to 26.7 without issues
description: Upgrade per MOP-UPG-02; alarm sync verified in NetAct.
learning: Upgrade per MOP-UPG-02; alarm sync verified in NetAct.

title: Subscribers rejected: license limit reached on new CMM-06
description: Lift-and-shift of CMM-06 onto the new cloud infrastructure.
symptoms: Capacity alarm 'license limit reached' during peak hour.
commands: show license capacity; show subscriber count
root_cause: The migration procedure omitted the license re-installation step.
resolution: Installed the correct capacity license for the new node ID; rejects stopped immediately.
learning: After any migration, verify installed license capacity matches the old node before the traffic swing.

title: Hosts unreachable after gateway switchover on CR-05
description: Redundancy test: mastership moved from CR-05 to its pair.
symptoms: Only part of the hosts recovered after mastership moved to the backup router.
commands: clear arp-cache
root_cause: Gratuitous ARP was disabled on the VRRP group, so ARP caches stayed stale.
resolution: Enabled VRRP virtual MAC/GARP and repeated the failover test in the next window.
learning: Have 'clear arp' commands ready as part of the failover rollback plan.

title: Prefix-list update on ER-21
description: Customer prefix added; BGP advertisement verified.
learning: Customer prefix added; BGP advertisement verified.

title: NetAct lost management of CMG-09 post SW update
description: Release activation on CMG-09; NOC noticed missing alarms next morning.
symptoms: Alarm upload failed and PM files were missing for 6 hours after the change.
commands: snmpget -v3 -u netact <node> sysUpTime.0
root_cause: The SNMP USM user was recreated with a default auth key during the upgrade.
resolution: Restored the SNMP config from backup and triggered a NetAct alarm resync.
learning: Back up SNMP/OSS integration settings before upgrades.

title: Integration of ENB-4415
description: Site integrated; KPIs within target after 24h.
learning: Site integrated; KPIs within target after 24h.

title: Edge router ER-25 lost jumbo MTU after firmware upgrade
description: Planned firmware upgrade on ER-25 during the night window.
symptoms: Peering flaps and OSPF adjacency stuck in EXSTART after the reload.
commands: show interface | include MTU; ping <peer> size 9000 df-bit
root_cause: Firmware reload wiped the interface MTU overrides; MTU on both ends no longer matched.
resolution: Pinned MTU 9216 in the post-upgrade config template and re-applied it; sessions stable.
learning: Verify interface MTU on both ends after any router firmware upgrade before re-enabling peering.

title: Junos upgrade on CR-05
description: Upgrade completed; routes and protocols verified.
learning: Upgrade completed; routes and protocols verified.
